mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine starting your day just like any other—coffee in hand, mind on the usual plans—only to have everything change in a heartbeat. Suddenly, the world inside the Twin Towers is turned upside down, and thousands find themselves in a desperate race against time, against fate itself. In Jim Dwyer’s powerful work, 102 Minutes: The Untold Story of the Fight to Survive Inside the Twin Towers, we’re invited to step inside those moments. Not just to witness tragedy, but to truly feel the human resilience that emerged from it. Together, we’ll explore the lived experiences of ordinary people thrust into extraordinary circumstances—where routine gave way to chaos, confusion, and, most of all, courage. As we journey through these stories, you’ll notice how walls between strangers seem to disappear, and how acts of heroism spring up from the most unexpected places. You’ll hear voices that were nearly lost, and discover tiny details that made all the difference. Picture smoke-filled hallways, decisions made in a split second, and the raw urgency that pulses through every corridor. Each choice, each act of kindness or bravery, draws a vivid portrait of survival under the most unimaginable pressure. By the end, what happened in the towers becomes more than just a page in a history book. It’s a profound reminder of what the human spirit is truly capable of—especially when every second counts. So, let’s set out together on this journey, and discover not just what happened, but what it truly means to survive.
